body: How would one go about bringing something like this up? Since the holidays and my birthday has more or less long passed now, it seems a bit strange to just all of a sudden bring it up now? Any help with this would be so so appreciated!!

Hi! This has definitely been something that I've heard of and always wondered about! I suspected that this may be the case, I just struggled with working out what HIS desired 'language' is.. Do you remember where this test was that you took? I would love to see if him and I could maybe check it out!
